name: usage-meter
description: A labeled meter for a limit: seats 8 of 10, storage 4.2 of 5 GB, API calls. It warns at 80 percent and at the limit with words and an icon, not only color, and can offer an upgrade when near the limit. UsageMeterList shows several. Built on role="meter"; the app owns the numbers. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.
